title: wallers inflation signal 2026 09 04
text:
Watch and follow on Spotify. Listen on the Reuters app.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller is urging policymakers to "give disinflation a chance," lowering expectations for a September rate hike. Investors are now watching the August jobs report for fresh clues on the economy. And record-high diesel prices are adding to inflation worries ahead of winter.
